cohort: The study participants were 13,828 pregnant women from an initial cohort of 64,999 in China, whose serum was collected during the second trimester.
finding: High maternal AFP concentration during the second trimester was positively associated with an increased risk of preterm birth, while b-HCG showed no statistically significant association.
cross-section timing: Data was collected retrospectively between January 2006 and December 2011.
